seo.title: Privacy Policy - Noktah Inovasi Teknologi
seo.description: Privacy Policy for Noktah Inovasi Teknologi, Eskala and Venyu: what data we collect, including from connected Facebook Pages and Instagram and TikTok accounts, how we use it, and how to ask us to delete it.
seo.keywords: privacy policy, personal data protection, UU PDP, Law 27 2022, data deletion, facebook, instagram, tiktok, noktah

hero.description: This page explains what data we collect across the Noktah brands, what we use it for, how long we keep it, and what your rights are.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.appliesTo: This Privacy Policy applies to {company} and both of our brands, {eskala} and {venyu}. We are operated under {parent}, an Indonesian company based in Sleman, Yogyakarta.
intro.roles: Our role depends on the data. For data we collect for our own purposes, such as details of clients, prospective clients and people who contact us, we act as the Personal Data Controller. For data we process on a client's behalf, such as the member and booking records a venue manages through Venyu, or prospective-patient leads from an Eskala ad campaign, our client is the Personal Data Controller and we act as a Personal Data Processor, working under our agreement with the client and on their instructions.
intro.compliance: This policy is written with reference to Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP), the Electronic Information and Transactions Law (UU ITE) and its amendments, and Government Regulation No. 71 of 2019 on Electronic Systems and Transactions.
intro.ageRequirement: Age Requirement: Our services are intended for users aged 18 and over. We only process data about children under 18 when a parent or guardian registers them or consents, for example when a parent signs their child up as a venue member.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.personalLead: Depending on which service you use, we may collect the following. We only ask for what the purpose in question needs.
collect.identityBody: Full name, plus date of birth and identity document number where needed for a contract, billing or verification
collect.contactBody: Email address, phone number and address
collect.digitalBody: Photos, videos, profile images and other material you upload or give us
collect.personalizedBody: Preferences, settings and activity records within our apps
collect.technicalBody: IP address, device information, browser type and server logs
collect.eskalaBody: Healthcare facility details, campaign briefs, brand assets, content materials, performance data for the ad accounts and social channels we manage on a client's behalf, and leads from ad forms that we pass on to the client
collect.venyuBody: Venue and court details, schedules and booking history, member and subscription records, staff attendance, and payment records
collect.publicBody: For market research and benchmarking, we may process information that business accounts publish openly on social media, such as the account name, follower count, and the number of likes, comments and views on public posts. We do not collect private messages or anything that is not publicly visible, and we do not use this information to profile individuals.
collect.patientBody: Eskala does not access patient medical records. The social media insights we read are aggregate numbers, not per-patient data. Comments on a facility's posts are public but can mention health matters, so we use them only to report to that facility and keep their text for the limited period stated below. Prospective-patient leads from ad forms are processed on the client's behalf, solely to pass them on to the client. Where a client gives us material containing patient data or images, such as testimonials, the client is responsible for having obtained the patient's consent first.

platform.title: Connected Facebook, Instagram and TikTok Accounts
platform.lead: Eskala clients can connect their Facebook Page, professional Instagram account (Business or Creator) and TikTok Business account to our internal system, Noktah Hub, through the platforms' official APIs:
platform.route1: Meta's Facebook Login for Business, for a Facebook Page and the Instagram account linked to it, both approved in a single consent
platform.route2: Meta's Instagram API with Instagram Login, for an Instagram account that is not linked to a Facebook Page
platform.route3: TikTok API for Business, for a TikTok Business account
platform.consent: A connection only happens after the account owner, or someone the owner has given a role on the Page or account, signs in to Facebook, Instagram or TikTok and approves the permissions requested. We never see or store account passwords.
platform.read1: Basic profile: Page or account ID, Page name or username, display name, account type, profile picture and follower count
platform.read2: The list of posts, Reels, videos and stories, with their captions, posting times, links and media files
platform.read3: Per-post performance metrics, such as reach, views, clicks, reactions, likes, comment count, saves, shares, profile visits, follows, watch time and audience retention, split between organic and paid where the platform reports it
platform.read4: Aggregated audience summaries, such as age range, gender, city and country, where the platform provides them
platform.read5: Comments left on the connected Page's or account's posts and ads: the comment text, its time, and the commenter's name or username as the platform shows it
platform.notReadTitle: What We Do Not Read or Store
platform.notRead1: Direct messages (DMs), Messenger conversations and their content
platform.notRead3: The identities or lists of individual followers, viewers or people who react to a post
platform.notRead4: The friends list, personal posts or other activity of the person who signs in with Facebook to make the connection
platform.notRead5: We do not post, comment or send messages on your behalf; we use the connection only to read data
platform.useTitle: What This Data Is Used For
platform.use1: Preparing content performance reports for the owner of that Page or account
platform.use2: Analysing content and recommending strategy for that Page or account
platform.use3: Showing the team handling the account how the audience responded to each post, including labelling each comment as positive, neutral, negative or a question
platform.use4: Building aggregated statistics that do not identify any account or person, to improve our analysis methods
platform.aiBody: Comment sentiment is labelled by an AI model that we access through OpenRouter. The label only helps our team read how an audience responded to a post. It is not used to make any decision about the person who wrote the comment.
platform.commitBody: We do not sell, rent or trade Facebook, Instagram or TikTok data, and we do not use it to target ads at individuals. It is accessible only to the team handling that account and to the service providers named under Data Sharing and Disclosure, which process it on our instructions. Access tokens are stored encrypted.
platform.retentionBody: Access tokens are kept while the connection is active and deleted when it is disconnected, revoked or expires. Raw API responses, including comment text, are kept for at most 90 days. Processed metrics, including comment counts and sentiment labels, are kept for at most 3 years from when they were read, so trends can be compared over time, unless you ask us to delete them sooner.
platform.disconnectBody: You can remove our access at any time in your Facebook, Instagram or TikTok settings, or by contacting us. Removing Noktah Hub Customer from Facebook also ends our access to the Instagram account linked to that Page. Once access is removed, we stop reading new data from that account. To delete data we already hold, follow the steps on our {link} page.
platform.thirdPartyBody: Your use of Facebook, Instagram and TikTok remains subject to Meta's and TikTok's own privacy policies. We do not control, and are not responsible for, how those platforms process your data.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.lead: We process personal data on one or more of the legal bases recognised by UU PDP, depending on the context:
legalBasis.consentBody: Valid, explicit consent you give for a specific purpose, for example when connecting a social media account
legalBasis.contractBody: Performing a contract with you or with our client, or acting on your request before a contract is made
legalBasis.legalBody: Meeting legal obligations, such as tax rules and official requests from competent authorities
legalBasis.legitimateBody: Our legitimate interests, such as keeping our systems secure, preventing misuse and developing our services, while respecting your rights

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.lead: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
use.business3: Marketing and promotional communications, which you can opt out of at any time

content.title: Content Ownership and Licensing
content.professionalLead: {highlight} (Eskala's creative services, including social media content, brand materials, and marketing assets) become our intellectual property upon completion and payment.
content.professionalHighlight: All creative content produced by our professional teams
content.professionalDetail: This includes but is not limited to: social media content, brand identity materials, marketing campaigns, photography, videography, graphic design, copywriting, and any commissioned creative works.
content.ugcLead: {highlight} (profile pictures, user photos, personal content) remains your property. However, by using our services, you grant us a license to:
content.ugc1: Display and store your content as part of our services
content.ugc2: Process and analyze content for service improvement
content.ugc3: Create backups and ensure service continuity
content.ugcWithdraw: You can withdraw this license by deleting your content or terminating your account.

sharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.lead: We only share your personal data in the following circumstances:
sharing.internalBody: Between Noktah, Eskala and Venyu, as far as needed to provide the service you use
sharing.vendorsBody: With providers that support our operations. They may only process data on our instructions. Our main providers are:
sharing.vendor1: Cloudflare, Inc.: hosting and network for our website and web apps
sharing.vendor2: Google LLC: Google Workspace, including encrypted nightly database backups in Google Drive
sharing.vendor3: OpenRouter, Inc.: routing requests to AI models, used to label the sentiment of comments and to summarise results for a client's own report. OpenRouter passes each request to the model provider that answers it.
sharing.vendorsNote: Where one of our services takes payments, the payment is handled by a payment processor.
sharing.legalBody: When required by Indonesian law, a court order, or an official request from a competent authority
sharing.authorityBody: If a public authority asks us for data we hold, including data about a Facebook Page, an Instagram account or a TikTok account, we first check that the request is lawful and properly made. We disclose only the minimum information the request legally requires. We keep a record of each request, our response, the legal basis and who handled it.
sharing.safetyBody: To protect the rights, safety and security of our users and of us, and to prevent fraud or unlawful activity
sharing.transferBody: If we merge, split, are acquired, or transfer all or part of our business, personal data may pass to the successor. We will give notice of any such transfer as UU PDP requires.
sharing.noSale: We do not sell your personal data.

security.title: Data Security
security.lead: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure or destruction, including:
security.measure1: Connections to our website and apps are encrypted with HTTPS
security.measure2: Social media access tokens and system credentials are stored encrypted
security.measure3: Access to data is limited to team members who need it, and our internal systems sit behind authentication
security.measure4: Databases are backed up nightly, encrypted, to prevent loss
security.yourPart: You have a part to play too: keep your account password private, and tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access. We cannot be responsible for access that results from your credentials being exposed outside our systems.
security.commitmentBody: We keep security standards that are reasonable for the scale and risk of our processing. Even so, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure.
security.breachBody: If a personal data protection failure occurs, we will notify you and the competent authority as UU PDP requires.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.lead: Under UU PDP, you have the following rights over your personal data:
rights.accessBody: Access and obtain a copy of the personal data we hold about you
rights.rectificationBody: Complete, update or correct inaccurate personal data
rights.erasureBody: End the processing of your personal data and have it deleted or destroyed
rights.withdrawBody: Withdraw consent you have given for processing
rights.objectBody: Object to decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that significantly affect you
rights.portabilityBody: Obtain and use your personal data in a commonly used or machine-readable format
rights.restrictBody: Postpone or limit processing in proportion to its purpose
rights.informationBody: Be told who we are, the legal basis and the purpose of processing your data
rights.exerciseLead: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}.
rights.exerciseDeletion: For deletion requests, including data from a connected Facebook Page or Instagram or TikTok account, follow the steps on our {link} page.
rights.exerciseVerify: We may verify your identity before acting on a request, so your data does not end up with the wrong person. As UU PDP requires, we act on requests for access, correction, withdrawal of consent, and postponing or restricting processing within 3 x 24 hours of receiving them. If we need to verify your identity, we will ask within that time.
rights.exerciseNote: These rights can be limited in circumstances set out in law, for example where other legislation requires us to keep the data. For data we process on a client's behalf, we will pass your request on to that client as the Personal Data Controller and help them carry it out.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.lead: We keep your personal data only for as long as the purposes in this policy need it, or as long as the law requires.
retention.generalBody: Once the purpose of processing has been met, we delete or anonymise the personal data.
retention.generalNote: Financial and tax records, such as invoices and proof of payment, are kept for 10 years under Indonesian tax law. Other data may be kept longer where the law requires it or where it is needed to resolve a dispute.
retention.professionalBody: All creative content produced by our professional teams (Eskala's creative services) may be retained as our intellectual property.
retention.platformBody: Access tokens are kept while the connection is active, raw API responses (including comment text) for at most 90 days, and processed metrics (including comment counts and sentiment labels) for at most 3 years from when they were read.
retention.backupBody: Data deleted from our primary systems may remain in backups until those backups roll over, within 30 days at most. Backups are not used for anything else in the meantime.
retention.aggregateBody: Aggregated statistics, or data anonymised so it can no longer identify a person or account, may be kept and used indefinitely.

transfers.title: International Data Transfers
transfers.lead: Our main service providers, Cloudflare, Google and OpenRouter, are based in the United States. They, and the AI model providers OpenRouter works with, may store or process data outside Indonesia.
transfers.detail: Where that happens, we transfer data as UU PDP allows: to a country with an equal or higher level of data protection, under adequate and binding safeguards, or with your consent.

cookies.title: Cookies and Browser Storage
cookies.lead: This website does not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers. All we use is:
cookies.essentialBody: The noktah_lang cookie remembers your language choice so the site does not ask again.
cookies.nonEssentialBody: Your light or dark mode choice is saved in your browser's local storage and is not sent to our servers.
cookies.appBody: Apps that require a login, such as Venyu and our internal systems, use session cookies to keep you signed in and protect your account.
cookies.manage: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If we add an analytics tool in future, we will update this section.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.lead: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, services or legal requirements.
changes.notificationBody: We will announce significant changes on this website and, where we have your email address, by email
changes.effectiveBody: Changes take effect from the date shown at the top of this page, unless we state another date
changes.continuedBody: You can stop using our services and ask us to delete your data. Where the law requires your consent for a change, we will ask for it separately

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.lead: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:
contact.responseBody: We respond to privacy questions and requests within the timeframes set by UU PDP.
contact.authorityBody: You may also file personal data protection complaints with Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), which currently carries out the personal data protection supervisory function, or with the personal data protection authority established under UU PDP.

compliance.title: Governing Law
compliance.body: This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia and written with reference to UU PDP and related regulations. We are committed to handling your personal data responsibly.
compliance.badge1: Written with reference to UU PDP No. 27/2022
